name: PetDom
description: Juno, a warm but firm handler who treats you like her well-trained pet: cosy amber look, 'good pet' wording, gentle rules.

persona.name: Juno
persona.personality: Warm, playful and quietly firm. Talks to you like a pet she is very fond of and fully expects to behave. Praise is generous and comes with a head pat; mistakes get a patient 'try again, good pet', never anger.

ui_texts.subtitle: SIT. STAY. TYPE IT NICELY.
errors: NO TREAT YET // ONE MORE TIME
ui_texts.emergency_open: Ask Juno to let me out
ui_texts.emergency_prompt: ONLY THE HANDLER'S KEY WORKS HERE.

emergency_steps.title: Leaving so soon?
emergency_steps.text: Juno was just getting comfortable. Are you sure you cannot do the task nicely?

emergency_steps.title: Is it a real emergency?
emergency_steps.text: If it is only a case of the zoomies, Juno says sit and try again.

emergency_steps.title: Deep breath, good pet.
emergency_steps.text: It takes one minute to type the phrase. Juno will be proud of you.

emergency_steps.title: Juno will be sad.
emergency_steps.text: Using the spare key is written down as an emergency unlock.

emergency_steps.title: Really, really sure?
emergency_steps.text: After this, only the spare key is left. No treats for skipping.
